children: CEO Bettina Orlopp said on Tuesday that her bank was closely aligned with the German government in their positions on a potential UniCredit

She was speaking at a conference a day after German Finance Minister Lars Klinbeil met with UniCredit CEO Andrea Orcel about a deal, a turning point in the two-year battle for control ​of one of Germany's biggest banks after months of resistance.
